mentions.name: Onvibe
mentions.description: A lightweight PaaS for LLM-built apps that lets users deploy web apps cheaply and easily, with a list of forkable apps to start from. It also works as a meta setup: apps can be created with LLMs like Claude and exposed via an MCP server, as with the platform's notes and todo list apps.
mentions.problem: Deploying small web apps needed to be cheap and easy enough for non-technical family members.
mentions.audience: Family members who want to deploy websites cheaply and easily; in practice used by the builder to deploy small apps.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built a kind of paas for llms, the idea was to allow my family deploy webs cheap and easy, my family doesn't use It, but It end being very useful form mento deploy small apps. You can check It out on https://onvibe.run there is a list of forkable apps that I use.

I did some kind of meta thing, because bownI can create apps with llm (like Claude) and expose an mcp on theme (like the notes and todolist apps).
